personality_one_liner: Clean, map-first architecture with high-contrast functional UI, inspired by Uber and RedBus.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability, safe areas strictly respected.

do's: Floating action bottom sheets overlaid on map views.
Persistent sticky summaries at the bottom of the seat selection screen.
dont's: Do not apply glass to data-heavy admin dashboards.
Do not blur standard list cards.

screens.name: HomeSearch_Passenger
screens.purpose: Map-first search interface allowing users to filter and find rides easily.

states.loading: Map loading skeleton with pulsing overlay
states.empty: No rides found for the selected route. Prompt to change dates or vehicle type.
states.error: Failed to load routes. Retry button.

screens.layout: Map view covering 70% of screen. Floating bottom sheet at the bottom for 'Where to?', 'Date' inputs, and Vehicle type filter pills (Car/Tempo/Bus). Use Deep Navy for text and Emerald Green for the main 'Search' CTA button.

screens.name: VehicleListing
screens.purpose: List available rides with clear details and pricing.

states.empty: No vehicles available for this route.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll list. Each card has a 16px border-radius, subtle shadow (shadow tier 1). Inside: Driver photo avatar on the left, Name and rating (Amber Yellow) next to it. Vehicle model and departure time right-aligned. Bottom row of card: Seat availability badge and Price/seat. CTA to select seats.

screens.name: SeatSelection
screens.purpose: Visual representation of vehicle layout allowing intuitive seat picking.
screens.layout: Grid-based visual seat map (columns based on vehicle type). Seat states: Available (surfaceSecondary with border), Selected (Emerald Green background), Booked (surfaceTertiary/disabled). Sticky bottom sheet with Trip Summary (seats selected, total price) and an Emerald Green 'Continue to Checkout' button.

screens.name: DigitalTicket
screens.purpose: Post-booking confirmation displaying the QR code and driver contact info.
screens.layout: Central elevated card resembling a physical ticket. QR code at the center. Driver contact details (unlocked post-payment) below it. Actions to download or share.

screens.name: DriverDashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of driver earnings, upcoming trips, and vehicle status.

states.empty: No upcoming rides. Add a route.

screens.layout: Top section: Earnings summary (50/50 split prominently displayed) with an Emerald Green 'Withdraw' CTA. Middle section: 'My Vehicle' registration status. Bottom section: List of upcoming passenger bookings.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of platform operations for the admin.
screens.layout: Grid of key metric cards (Total Revenue, Active Drivers, Total Bookings). Below that, a list of 'Pending Vehicle Approvals' with quick Accept/Reject actions. Deep Navy headers, structured data density.

driver_avatar.alt: Smiling driver leaning out of vehicle

driver_dashboard_bg.alt: Driver hands on steering wheel dashboard

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Deep Navy Blue (brandPrimary) for core UI anchors, Emerald Green (brandSecondary/success) for booking actions/buttons, Amber Yellow (warning) for ratings, and Light Gray (surfaceSecondary) for backgrounds and inactive elements.
Implement a Map-first layout on the HomeSearch_Passenger screen. Use the 'map_background' image behind a floating `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` (with glassmorphism enabled) for search inputs.

For the SeatSelection screen, build an interactive grid (columns adapt to car/tempo/bus). Empty seats should have a border, selected seats must use the Emerald Green color, and booked seats should be inactive/greyed out.
Cards across the app MUST have a 16px border-radius (`lg` token) and a subtle shadow (tier 1), aligning with the requested Uber/RedBus minimal aesthetic.
Primary call-to-actions, like 'Search' or 'Continue to Checkout', should stick to the bottom above the home indicator, especially on scrollable screens, using the Emerald Green color.
In the DigitalTicket screen, use a stylized ticket view with an embedded QR code placeholder. Driver details remain hidden/obfuscated before payment is complete.
Never use Indigo, Violet, Purple, or any Blues other than the explicitly requested Deep Navy Blue.
Ensure Loading, Empty, and Error states fill the flex layout appropriately for every data-fetching screen.
